currentParagraphText: “Locally in this district? Forty-seven. It fluctuates a bit as some of them migrate around, and some evolve while others are killed off, but this is one of the areas with not that many, so don’t worry too much. They aren’t the strongest either, and they tend not to bother with weaker C-grades, so you should be fine.”
